EmailTemplate.description: FQS Stewardship Response — standard shell template for the automated post-acknowledgement stewardship touch sent by the FQS_Stewardship_Response flow. Stewardship is distinct from acknowledgement: it is a follow-up outreach to deepen the donor's connection to the mission after the initial thank-you has been sent. Placeholder copy is intentional; marketing should replace body text before go-live.
